composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the diorama centered and filling about 75% of the frame with even margins (at least 12% on every side). It is a small compact diorama group — a handful of miniature objects standing together — not a room interior: no walls, no ceiling, no floor plane. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the diorama floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadows only within the objects. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
walls, ceiling, windows or a room interior
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the diorama
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the diorama.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の「調理場」を表す小さな調理道具ジオラマの master asset（純粋な visual）。人物・壁・床・背景は仕様として意図的に描かない — 登場人物も文字も UI 層が上に重ねるので、この画像は透過背景に浮く道具だけで正しい。人がいないこと・部屋がないことは欠陥ではなく要件
scene: a miniature school kitchen diorama with no people in it: two large rounded stainless-steel cooking pots standing on a low pale counter, a neat stack of cream serving containers beside them, and a small wheeled cart standing next to the counter. Soft matte metal rendered as clay, warm cream and beige counter. The material must be the SAME matte hand-pressed clay as the attached approved kitchen tile and the cream lunch tray — hand-formed clay pots with soft rounded edges, never realistic brushed steel, never photographic reflections. Same lighting and same warm palette as the delivery truck and the dish set. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
required_objects: two large pots on a counter
